dedupe_keys.name: office of utilities regulation jamaica telecommunications market information reports quarterly

description: The Office of Utilities Regulation, Jamaica's regulator for telecommunications, electricity and water, publishes a quarterly Telecommunications Market Information Report. The July to September 2025 edition, published in 2026, has 31 pages of charts on fixed voice subscriptions and penetration, domestic and international fixed voice revenues and average revenue per user, mobile voice and data subscriptions, traffic and revenue, and fixed broadband. The listing shows editions from at least 2022, and the same page lists the licensees of the telecommunications sector, updated in August 2026. Coverage: Jamaica, national totals by quarter and by service. Format and access: PDF reports on the OUR website, free; no licence is stated and the reports carry a disclaimer on accuracy. Caveats: charts, not tables, so values must be read from figures or labels; publication lags the quarter by six months or more; operator-level figures are limited. Simulation uses: quarterly demand and revenue series for Jamaican telecom capacity planning and for tracking the effect of hurricanes such as Beryl (2024) and Melissa (2025) on subscriptions and traffic. Related records: data-itu-ict-statistics gives annual Jamaican indicators; data-ookla-open-data-performance-tiles gives measured speeds in Jamaica.
licence: not stated (only a site copyright notice on the provider pages read on 2026-09-28)
